blocks.text: From the Zscaler Admin Console, you can configure user privacy for various settings.
Zscaler Client Connector User Privacy settings provide you with the following benefits and allow you to:

blocks.item: Comply with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) by disabling or enabling the collection of device owner and machine hostname information.
Enable packet capture and allow non-administrator users access to log files for troubleshooting.
Restrict packet capture to only administrators.
Protect user information by disabling automatic uploading of crash reports.
Collect geolocation information if Digital Experience (ZDX) is enabled on a device.
Provide users flexibility by allowing them to change default parameters for Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) 2.0 or Private Access protocol settings.
Protect traffic from malicious PAC files by enforcing secure PAC URLs.

blocks.text: On the User Privacy page (Infrastructure > Advanced Settings > User Privacy), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Configure Zscaler Client Connector to collect device owner information.
Configure Zscaler Client Connector to collect machine hostname information.
Enable the Start Packet Capture option for Zscaler Client Connector.
Allow end user to override Z-Tunnel 2.0 or Private Access protocol settings.
Allow access to Client Connector logs folder for non administrators.
Enable Auto System Info and Log Fetch.
Enable the Do not Explicitly Bypass the Subdomains of FQDNs option.
